# OCUDU Infra SRS

> Infrastructure and E2E test suite for [OCUDU](https://gitlab.com/ocudu), a 5G CU-DU stack.
> Tests cover the full RAN stack using simulators (Amarisoft, Viavi), external 5G cores (Open5GS, Amarisoft MME), and real hardware (COTS UEs, O-RUs, SDRs).
> Combines the Retina testing framework (Python/pytest on Kubernetes), GitLab CI/CD pipelines, and Terraform modules to provision the infrastructure.

## Overview

- [Main README](./README.md): Project description, pipeline diagram, and test execution flow

## E2E Testing

- [How to write tests](./e2e/tests/README.md): Terminology (Testbed, Test Step, Test Case, Test Suite), folder structure (`configs/`, `criteria/`, `steps/`, `suites/`), suite YAML format and how they map to CI jobs

## Retina Framework

- [Retina README](./retina/README.md): What Retina is, architecture (agents on K8s nodes, central orchestrator, pytest), documentation index
- [How to add metrics/criteria](./retina/protocol/criteria.md): Steps to add new metrics: `base.proto` → agent (JSON/PCAP analyzer) → launcher (`public.py`) → test YAML
- [Run local tests](./retina/_scripts/README.md)
- [How to parse tests artifacts](./retina/launcher/artifacts.md)
